component.name: Keyslot
component.summary: A native GNOME client for KeePassXC databases

description.p: Browse and edit local KeePass databases with a native GTK4 and libadwaita interface. KeePassXC handles database encryption and storage.
Includes search, credential copying, password generation, attachments, and a companion GNOME Quick Settings extension.
This is an early development release. It does not yet provide full feature parity with KeePassXC.
